children: Northrop Grumman received an $862.8 million contract to build missile devices for the Army.
The defense contractor will build, inspect, test, package and deliver M1156 precision guidance kits, which are GPS-guided devices used for missiles.
The award is a firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract.
The work is due to be completed by Sept. 3, 2031.
